name: Samsung TV Remote
author: Ryan Doupe
description: Ask your agent to bind it to Super+R and customize the app bindings to what you like. Arrows to move, Enter for OK, Backspace for back, - and = for volume, M for mute, P for on and off, 1-9 for your apps. Scroll the bar icon for volume, right-click to mute. Held keys repeat like the real remote. Wakes the TV and reopens what you were watching. Finds the TV by itself, no IP to enter. Samsung Tizen TVs, 2016 and newer.

barWidget.description: Super+R to open, arrows, Enter and Backspace to drive the TV, 1-9 for your apps. Volume, hold-to-repeat, wake-on-LAN.
